observations: Photo 0: Blue plastic water storage drum with flat circular lid secured by metal straps/hinges; small round cap/port on top.
Photo 0: No obvious cracks/holes visible from this angle; surface shows scuffs/scratches and stains.
Photo 1: Same drum from another angle; lid straps and top cap/port visible; wear marks on body.
Photo 1: No close-up of seams, lid gasket/sealing surface, or bottom area; no evidence of a leak test shown.

identity.kind: water storage drum / jerrycan-style plastic tank (food-grade claimed)

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Seller’s reply is text only; photos do not show food-grade/HDPE markings or certification.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Seller claims a test was done yesterday, but no leak-test video/photo or close-up of seams/gasket is provided.
General marketing statement; no measurable proof in photos or new evidence.

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade/certified (could be unknown prior contents).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of any embossed/printed material code (e.g., HDPE/food-grade markings) and any label/batch info on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used plastic water drum with unknown prior contents (worst case: not food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak may exist at the bottom seam or around the lid gasket/port—photos can’t confirm.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a leak test: fill with water and show no seepage around seams/lid for an extended period (overnight).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/needs inspection (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Top cap/port may not seal properly (gasket/seat not visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the top cap/port sealing surface and gasket; then a focused water-fill test around the port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lid/port seal not guaranteed (worst case: may require replacement of cap/gasket).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown; value depends on volume.
risks.proof: Photo with measuring tape (height and diameter) or a capacity marking on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity bracket until size is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send new photos showing: (1) any embossed/printed material/food-grade markings and capacity marking, (2) close-up of lid gasket/sealing surface and the top cap/port seat, (3) close-up of bottom seam.
Send a short video of the leak test (fill with water, show it stays without wet spots around seams/lid for at least overnight).
Confirm the exact capacity (liters) with a measuring tape photo or the printed capacity label.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not supported by any new visual evidence. Without leak-test proof and food-grade/capacity markings visible in photos, the item can’t be priced confidently beyond worst-case assumptions.
